If the player has defeated 12 possessed trainers in the tower, she will tutor [[bulbapedia:Dark Pulse (move)|Dark Pulse]] for ₽4,000. ===Pedestals=== On 7F, there are four pedestals for Strange Prisms on the left side of the room. Interacting with the white gravestone on the right side will give the player a quest to collect four Strange Prisms, and hints to their locations.
